messages:
Alex M: PR #8424 ready for review — updates SDK examples for streaming + pagination across Python/TypeScript/Go. Fixes an edge case where retries on transient 429s could lose the cursor; added unit tests for py/ts/go. CI is flaking on gofmt only. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8424
Samira K: Looking now. Do we have a small integration test that simulates a 429 + backpressure scenario? If not, can we add a unit mock for the retry hook so behavior is deterministic?
Alex M: Not full integration yet. I added py/tests/test_stream_retry.py that mocks the server returning 429 for the first chunk then resumes; ts and go have unit mocks. I also added a short README example showing the recommended retry_then_resume pattern. Example snippet (Python):
```python
from redwood import StreamingClient
client = StreamingClient()
stream = client.stream("gpt-open")
for chunk in stream.retry(max_attempts=3):
    if chunk.type == 'cursor':
        # resume cursor state preserved across retries
        state = chunk.cursor
        continue
    print(chunk.text)
```
Chris R: For the TypeScript example we should replace `stream.cancel()` with `stream.close()` — cancel is deprecated in v0.12. Also the doc still links to the old changelog anchor; update to https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk#streaming (I can send a small PR for that anchor fix).
Lina P: @Alex M can you add a short paragraph in the migration guide about preserving cursor state on retry? I'll review wording. Also add a gofmt pre-commit check — CI shouldn't block a docs merge for formatting alone.
Alex M: Will add migration note and the extra test. Pushing new commit now. @Docs Bot please run `render-docs` preview for the PR.
Docs Bot: render-docs started for PR #8424 — preview at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/8424 (status: queued)
Kevin T: LGTM once the preview looks good. One nit: Python example uses `max_attempts=3` but default is 5 — either show the default or explain why we lower it here for latency-sensitive streams.
Alex M: Good catch — I'll add a comment explaining we chose 3 to reduce tail latency for interactive streams, and include the default in a commented line. Marking for merge once deploy-preview passes and gofmt fixed. :+1:
Chris R: I'll push a tiny pre-commit hook to catch gofmt and run `gofmt -w` in the CI step; will follow up with a patch. :hammer_and_wrench:
